svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram of a tenant deployment: AWS onboarding places secrets through a write-only role the platform assumes with an ExternalId; the workflow is dispatched and the request ends; GitHub Actions then signs in through OIDC to a separate deployment identity, runs Terraform, and reports back by callback, with polling and reconciliation covering a lost callback.
